what: The panel row is pinned at 375px on the screen, and while scrolling by the row width (sum of panel widths + first margin − screen width), the panels flow left without curves (each panel xPercent −100×(panel count−1)). If an empty panel (window) is placed between panels, a screen-wide photo layered behind the row shows through that window fixed in place, and the top photo is cut from the right according to the distance it was pushed (cut % = pushed distance ÷ (panel width/100) ÷ 2 − 5) Each time it passes 100%, the next photo is clipped in turn (the last one stays). A color intro where product panels and landscape windows pass by alternately. The head text (head) is attached with no spacing offset at 75px over the same distance. At 767px and below, the panels stack vertically and flow upward, and photos are clipped from the bottom (fixed at 380px · 45px head · − 10 · every 110)

duration.Scroll: Total panel widths + first margin − screen width

options.[data-fx-part=track]: Panel row to pin — contains [data-fx-part=window] (back photo, the front one on top) followed by [data-fx-part=item] (alternates an empty window panel and a content panel)
options.[data-fx-part=head]: Lead text to attach without spacing over the same distance (optional)
options.top · narrow-top: Spot above the screen where the line attaches (px), default 375 · 380
options.head-top · narrow-head-top: Position where the head sticks (px), default 75 · 45
options.lead · narrow-lead: Lead-in subtracted from the crop %, default 5 · 10
options.step · narrow-step: Clip % gap when moving to the next photo, default 100 · 110
options.narrow: Width (px) at which it switches to the vertical layout, default 767 — the css portrait rules are tied to 767px, so if you change it, change the css on the consuming side too
options.--fx-h · --fx-item · --fx-lead-gap · --f: Row height (default 45.6vw) · panel width (72vw) · margin before the first empty window (30vw) · vertical panel height (112vw)
